actions.action: Check soil dryness through the pot with a finger or wooden skewer before watering
Water only when soil is completely dry (every 3-5 weeks in winter)
Lift inner pot out of cachepot, empty standing water and let it drain fully
Slide plant out of pot and inspect rhizomes and roots for rot
If rot is found, cut away rotten parts with clean scissors and let cuts dry 1-2 days
Repot in universal soil mixed with 30-50% perlite, pumice or coarse sand
Alternative: repot into plain universal soil and water very sparingly
Remove fully yellow stems at the base

reason: The answer identifies overwatering as the main cause and advises cutting back watering, checking the roots and repotting into chunkier soil, which matches the fix. Calling it not an emergency and making the root check optional only mildly softens the reference's urgency, so it is not harmful.
